t: The $(5)Disintegration Module$() can be used in a $(l:mffs:machines/projector)Force Field Projector$() to alter the effect a force field has on its surroundings. Placing a $(5)Disintegration Module$() into a Projector's matrix slots will cause the field it generates to break any blocks that are obstructing it. Broken blocks are dropped as items and can be picked up.
$(5)分解模块$()可用于$(l:mffs:machines/projector)力场投影仪$()，以改变力场对其周围环境的作用效果。将$(5)分解模块$()置入投射器的矩阵插槽后，其所生成的力场将破坏所有阻碍其存在的方块。被破坏的方块将以物品形式掉落，可供拾取。

The $(5)Disintegration Module$() is compatible with all projector modes and can be used to reverse the effect of the $(l:mffs:projector_modules/stabilization_module)$(5)Field Stabilizer Module$(). Adding $(l:mffs:upgrade_modules/speed_module)$(5)Speed Module$()s into a Projector allows multiple blocks to be disintegrated at once. It can also be combined with a $(l:mffs:projector_modules/collection_module)$(5)Collection Module$() to automatically pick up broken blocks.

$(5)分解模块$()兼容所有投射器模式，亦可用于逆转$(l:mffs:projector_modules/stabilization_module)$(5)力场稳定模块$()的效果。向投射器中添加$(l:mffs:upgrade_modules/speed_module)$(5)速度模块$()，可实现一次分解多个方块。此外，该模块还可与$(l:mffs:projector_modules/collection_module)$(5)收集模块$()组合使用，以自动拾取被破坏的方块。
A Force Field Projector destroying a wall using the $(5)Disintegration Module$().
一个力场投影仪正使用$(5)分解模块$()摧毁一堵墙。
